headline: Arc Insulation wins Rs 9.71 Cr order from MRA Composites
summary: Arc Insulation & Insulators secured a Rs 9.71 crore work order for GFRP Rebars. The order represents significant inflow relative to recent revenue trends, with execution details pending formal PO terms.

headline: Danish Power wins Rs 35 Cr order for BESS transformers
summary: Danish Power secured a Rs 35 crore work order from a leading IPP player for 20 MVA PCS Transformers. This order represents ~2.6% of FY26 revenue, with strong balance sheet capacity.

headline: Deem Roll Tech wins Rs 1 Cr export order for rolls
summary: Deem Roll Tech secures Rs 1 crore export purchase order from an overseas customer. The order represents a significant inflow relative to its small market cap, though TTM revenue data is unavailable.

headline: PTC Industries Q1FY27 revenue doubles to ₹192 crore
summary: PTC Industries reported a 97% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹19,180 lakh for Q1FY27 ahead of its proposed Qualified Institutions Placement.

headline: Steamhouse India Q1 results: profit up 79% YoY
summary: Steamhouse India posted Q1 net profit of 183m rupees, up from 102m a year ago. Revenue rose to 1.29b rupees from 1.1b, while EBITDA margin expanded to 24% from 17% YoY.

headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2FY27: Advances up 24.7% YoY
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported net advances of ₹5.77 lakh crore in Q2FY27, up 24.7% YoY, while total deposits rose 23.2% during the same period.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Kotak, Trent, IREDA in focus
summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank sees block trades, Trent hits 1,000 Zudio stores, and IREDA signs MoU with MNRE. Check key moves.

headline: Adani Power signs SHA for 770 MW Bhutan hydro project
summary: Adani Power and Druk Green Power signed a shareholders agreement for the 770 MW Chamkharchhu-I Hydropower Project in Bhutan. The 49:51 equity partnership aims to strengthen regional energy security.

headline: IEX electricity traded volume up 14.2% YoY in H1FY27
summary: Indian Energy Exchange achieved 77.2 BU electricity traded volume in H1FY27, a 14.2% YoY rise. September 2026 saw a record single-day RTM volume of 315 MU on September 26, 2026.

headline: Angel One discloses Sep 2026 and Q2FY27 business metrics
summary: Angel One's client base reached 39.98 Mn in September 2026, up 17.3% YoY. Commodity ADTO surged 86.4% YoY while overall equity market share stood at 19.6%.

headline: Patel Retail launches 23-product spice range
summary: Patel Retail Limited has launched a Whole Spices catalogue under its in-house brand 'Indian Chaska', comprising 23 products. The move expands its FMCG portfolio alongside existing retail operations.

headline: Seven & I closes 31 India stores, exits Reliance tie-up
summary: Seven & I has shut down 31 stores in India and ended its partnership with Reliance, marking a significant exit from the Indian retail market.

headline: Shyam Metalics Q2FY27 Sales: Volumes up, Realizations mixed
summary: Shyam Metalics & Energy reports Q2FY27 sales release. Metallics volumes surged 54.89% YoY, while Carbon Steel (Flat) volumes jumped 164.38% YoY.

headline: Glenmark launches Adapalene Gel pump packs in US
summary: Glenmark Therapeutics Inc. USA introduced Adapalene Gel USP, 0.1% in new pump packs, targeting a $45.8 million annual market for the Differin equivalent.

headline: Honasa Q2FY27 update: NSV growth in early 30s
summary: Honasa Consumer Ltd reports robust Q2FY27 operating update with NSV growth in early 30s YoY. Mamaearth grew high-teens, while younger brands accelerated to mid-40s.

headline: FMCG firms eye price hikes amid rising input costs
summary: FMCG companies are preparing price hikes and smaller pack sizes as rising input costs pressure margins, with the festive season adding urgency to their pricing strategies.

headline: Divi's Labs, TVS Motor tipped for Nifty 50 inclusion
summary: Divi's Laboratories and TVS Motor are emerging as top contenders for inclusion in the Nifty 50 index, with potential passive inflows of up to $824 million anticipated.

headline: Centre may seek legal opinion on sterile drug licensing
summary: The Centre is considering seeking a legal opinion on sterile drug licensing following a Supreme Court ruling, signalling a potential policy review in pharmaceutical regulation.

headline: GSFC cancels Q2FY27 board meeting
summary: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd cancelled its board meeting scheduled for October 12, 2026, citing unavoidable circumstances. The meeting was set to approve Q2FY27 financial results.
